reviews.title: Bought refurbished- great deal
reviews.comment: I bought this refurbished for about half the price. It looked new to me and the sound is great. I’m not an audio nerd- this is perfect for the level I’m working at. Functional, good sound, easy interface. The tricky part was getting my laptop to cooperate. Hint: turn off windows ‘sound enhancements.’
reviews.author: Genna

reviews.title: 5 Star Plus
reviews.comment: Love this microphone. I got this to support conferencing such as Google Hangout, Zoom etc. I have used it on my Mac Mini, my Windows Laptop, and Chromebook. Works well on all three. Sound the other end of the wire is awesome. Yes it is definitely best if you yak close up to the thing, but it also is pretty good even at a distance. The retro look is very cool, and it is very stable and does not pick up too much vibration through the base. Overall I rate this 5 star, two thumbs up. Glad I bought this instead of the smaller siblings.  Worth it for business use as well as games, and social.  With the current social distancing, do yourself stand out from the crowd and don't sound like a turkey on the internet! Definitely recommended. BYTW, this Yeti was refurbished. Like new.
reviews.author: Dr.Seuss

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: Amazing. Perfect, everything I dreamed of and more.
reviews.author: Emmeline

reviews.title: An excellent mic if you're able to afford it
reviews.comment: Before I bought this microphone, I only used headset mics while talking with friends online, but eventually I decided that I don't want to keep getting entirely new headsets every time either the earphones or the mic goes bad. I wanted to get a desk microphone that would last, and after over 2 months of using this one nearly daily, it's working just fine. It has plenty of settings to adjust to whatever your needs may be, the only downside being that you probably can't just plug this in and go; you will need to find out what settings work best for you. I would also recommend getting a different sort of mount for it; although the standard base that comes with the mic is well made, it can get in the way while gaming and it picks up every keystroke and mouse click if you don't have your sensitivity low enough.
reviews.author: Landon Guenther

reviews.title: It works mostly.
reviews.comment: Being refurbished it functions but on occasion will distort the audio and you have to unplug and replug it. That’s specific to mine only though. When it works it’s fine.
